name: matrix-tasks-manager
description: Manager for individual Matrix Mission Tasks

scripts.install-tasks: npm install --prefix matrix-app && npm install --prefix "matrix-app -2" && npm install --prefix "matrix-app -3" && npm install --prefix "matrix-app -4" && npm install --prefix "matrix-app -5" && npm install --prefix "matrix-app -6"
scripts.start-tasks: concurrently "npm start --prefix matrix-app" "npm start --prefix \"matrix-app -2\"" "npm start --prefix \"matrix-app -3\"" "npm start --prefix \"matrix-app -4\"" "npm start --prefix \"matrix-app -5\"" "npm start --prefix \"matrix-app -6\""
